items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: I met them all, and I talked with them

ctx.x: Tommy Ladnier. He was a hot trumpet player out of New York at that time. On trombone he had a fellow named Moten. I just can't think of Moten's first name, but Moten played a beautiful trombone. In later years Moten made the original "One O'Clock Jump" with Count Basie. And he played the original -- the first solo played on "One O'Clock Jump" Moten played that with the Count Basie Band.
This is no relation to Bennie Moten?
